in_marathi.name: Jotsana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jotsana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jotsana is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jot', meaning 'knowledge'. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the deity of knowledge, music, and arts. The name Jotsana symbolizes wisdom, intelligence, and learning.
